decisions.reason: Focus unit has 災沴, a compound for natural disaster or calamity; calumny is a mistranslation. Replacing it with calamity matches the Chinese and aligns with the idiomatic field's disaster wording.

冀王 is the noble title Prince of Ji; Prince Ji of Ji wrongly treats 冀 as both a personal name and the fief. The proposed Prince of Ji is the correct English rendering and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
